name: HP extras
description: Extra software HP put on the PC. Tools that keep your drivers and BIOS up to date are kept.

items.name: HP Support Assistant
items.description: Keeps your HP PC's drivers and BIOS up to date, which fixes problems and security holes. Best kept.

items.name: HP Support Assistant
items.description: Keeps your HP PC's drivers and BIOS up to date, which fixes problems and security holes. Best kept.

items.name: myHP
items.description: HP's control centre for things like screen, sound and power settings. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: HP JumpStart
items.description: A welcome tour HP shows on new PCs. Not needed after the first day.

items.name: HP JumpStart
items.description: A welcome tour HP shows on new PCs. Not needed after the first day.

items.name: HP Privacy Settings
items.description: Asks whether HP can collect information about how you use the PC.

items.name: HP WorkWell
items.description: Reminds you to take breaks. Most people never open it.

items.name: HP Documentation
items.description: Manuals HP put on the PC. They're also on HP's website.

items.name: HP Connection Optimizer
items.description: Tries to pick the best Wi-Fi network. Windows already does this.

items.name: HP Notifications
items.description: Shows messages and offers from HP.

items.name: HP PC Hardware Diagnostics
items.description: Tests the PC's parts if something seems wrong. Handy to keep for repairs.

items.name: HP System Event Utility
items.description: Makes the special keys on HP keyboards work, like volume and brightness. Best kept.

items.name: HP Wolf Security
items.description: HP's extra security software. Keep it unless you've decided you don't need it.

items.name: HP Sure Click
items.description: Opens risky web pages and files in a safe area. Keep it unless you've decided you don't need it.

items.name: HP QuickDrop
items.description: Sends files between your phone and PC. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: HP Easy Clean
items.description: Locks the keyboard and screen while you clean them. Keep it if you use it.

items.name: HP Smart
items.description: HP's printer app. Keep it if you have an HP printer.
